reviews.comment: Professor Frauenfeld was awesome! He really does care about his students and the subject material that he is teaching and he made learning fun. The class is only graded on 3 exams and 6 quizzes. He rounds the exam average to an 80 and adds points to everyone's grade and if you stay after the quizzes, there's extra credit. Just be sure to study!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Study for tests and quizzes! He is very funny and gives lots of extra credit. He curves each exam and even your final grade. Love him!
This class was easy. As long as you study for each quiz and test, you will get an A. Study the slides and you should be fine. Honestly interesting at times

Excellant professor! He gives the slides before class. 12-question quizzes every two weeks with three exams (non-cumulative). He gives extra points based on the averages and curves grade. Overall, easy class and he's a nice person that makes jokes throughout lectures. He would always use memes as the quiz code LOL

He is a very solid professor and it's clear he is passionate about what he teaches. Most of your grade is determined by exams, but there are also quizzes every few lectures. Every test can be curved and after each quiz, by staying until the end of class, you will receive extra credit. Textbook is not required but there if you need it.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a good professor, very passionate. Study a lot for the tests of you want an A in the class.

Frauenfeld is a good prof. The class is test-heavy, but he curves the class average up to a B. There is a quiz about every two weeks, but if you stay till the end of class you can get extra credit. PAY ATTENTION to the lectures. The slides only have pictures, so you need to hear him explain it, and he'll point out what's on the quizzes.

No complaints. There's no final, only three midterms, and quizzes every other week with a big bonus for staying until the end. The class is mostly memorization, and test questions come straight from the slides. Overall, he's a great professor and I learned some fun facts.

This was not an EASY A - but a doable A if you do the work and study. He's a great professor but you have to keep up and you have to study for test. I made an A, attended all classes and I did like his class.
Not an easy A. This class made me feel really dumb. I tried so hard and got C's on everything.
He is a very nice professor who wants everyone to learn, but this class was really hard. There was no homework so it was hard to retain anything. Your grade is just quizzes and three tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Oliver Frauenfeld is an amazing professor. The entire class consists of 6 quizzes (12 questions each + 3 questions worth of extra credit for staying through the lecture) and 3 tests (curves the average up to an 80). Never went to any lectures and ended with a 101 in the class. Take this class with this professor for a ridiculously easy life science
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Frauenfeld is great! You can tell he deeply cares about the subject he teaches. He also gives extra credit if you stay to the end of class after a quiz
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing lecturer, but will talk for the whole time he is given.

He is competent, but the course is very lecture heavy, and the posted slides don
t always have all the information from the lecture slides

Professor Frauenfeld was great! This was a great science class, don't take it too lightly but it is not that bad lowk. Attendance is not mandatory, though his lectures are super informative and very helpful, with 6 scheduled quizzes (not pop, one drops, and if you stay till end of class +25-33% on them) he also curves exam avg to 80-also funny guy.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fantastic Professor! Super sweet and funny. Provides extra credit on quizzes if you stay till the end of class.
Exams are worth 78% of your grade
Professor Fauenfeld is one of the best science professors at TAMU. The class is extremely easy if you do it with just a little effort. I enjoyed this class; it was an easy A for a science credit.
Very easy class and try when tests come around. Very nice and wants people to show up and care about his lectures. Overall great professor and very clear on what is wanted and needed.

I love this professor! I took this class for a science credit and it was pretty easy. There is like one quiz every two weeks ish and four exams. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you don't go you might struggle on the quizzes and exams. He also gives extra credit for students who stay for the whole lecture. Take him!

He's a very good professor. His class consisted of 6 quizzes and he drops the lowest quiz grade. He gives 10 points extra credit on like half. His exams were multiple choice and not too challenging, some quiz questions repeat on the exam. He curves so that the average is 80. Literally just take good notes, study with Quizlet, and you'll be good!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Frauenfeld is so kind!! He loves what he is teaching, and his class is a nice grade booster. He gives tons of extra credit (stay till the end of class, he usually does bonus point activities then!), and his tests are not difficult if you go to class. He curved s24' by almost a letter grade at the end. Take him for your science credit!!

6 quizzes and 3 exams; no homework or final. Tests were easy IF you studied. He gives A LOT of curves. Most exams were curved by 10 points. For extra credit, if you stayed behind after quizzes, he would give you 30 points on your quiz. You do have to study a good amount, but his posted slides on canvas had everything you needed.

grade is based off quizzes and exams, but he offers a ton of extra credit, so make sure you go to class even though attendance isn't mandatory. He's a really nice guy and genuinely wants the students to do well. however, the class does require you to actually study and put in time, it's not just a blow off course.

Although it's labelled as a GEOG course, it's 85% about the atmosphere, but still easy enough to learn if you pay attention in class. Quizzes every couple of class days, most with extra credit if you stay after. 3 exams, non-cumulative, no final, no homework. Will curve the exams to increase the average, and only graded on quiz/test. Go to class!!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great guy & amazing lectures! Material is easy to understand overall, just be diligent in reviewing it when quiz & exam time comes around. Only about 6 quizzes & 3 exams to take during the whole year, however he'll tell you what is on it and information to remember. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but he has a lot of Extra Credit after quizzes, so go!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a lot goes into the grade book but he provides everything necessary in the slides to be successful on quizzes and exams. We had 6 quizzes every 3 classes and 3 exams. He gives lots of opportunity for extra points throughout the semester. I went to him multiple times for clarification on things and he really does care about students success.

Oliver was a super nice guy and easy to work with however the class material itself was difficult. If you do not have to take this level of geography I would not take this course even though he is a great guy. There are like 7 quizzes and 3 tests and that is all you get graded on for the whole semester but if you have to take it take it with him!

Definitely recommend this course BECUASE of Prof Frauenfeld. He loves what he teaches, is good at it, and is very organized. Quizzes are every 3rd class, 3 tests total. You can only get content from taking notes in class so attendance is important. Do study because there is a lot of content, if you need it he is very willing to help.

He's not the strongest speaker, but he clearly explains the material. There is no homework in his class. Go to the lectures and write down everything the man says. Come test time, summarize the notes you have, and study that. You will have success. Tests are all multiple choice.
lectures lowkey boring. content easy. only quizzes and tests make up grades. very doable. personally easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The tests are hard, but he gives tons of bonus and extra credit. Just study a little bit, and you will get an A.

Dr. Frauenfeld is very clear with his lectures but can sometimes be difficult to hear. Pay attention to the slides and review notes before each class to prepare for the quizzes. Grades are based solely on quizzes and tests, but he consistently gave out curves and multiple extra credit opportunities.

Somewhat boring lectures. However, everything is laid out nicely and test/quiz questions are taken directly from the notes. Make sure to show up to and put effort into this class and you will be fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You can tell he's really passionate about this course, which is good because most of the times the content is very boring. He offers a lot of extra credit and curves lots of grades. Dr. Frauenfeld is very knowledgable, nice, and he cares a lot about what he teaches. If you're good with memorization, definitely take the class. this class sucked but only because i didn't go to class. if u take notes during his lectures you should be fine. he doesn't post his notes and has quizzes every third class.

reviews.comment: Dr. Frauenfeld is one of the best at TAMU. He is caring, flexible, and understands that students have lives. reviews.comment: Such a good professor! Very kind and seemed like he genuinely cared for us students and wanted us to do well. reviews.comment: Overall, the class is fairly interesting and wasn't difficult. The only grades were the 7 quizzes we had every other week. Since I did bad on two quizzes, my grade wasn't what I wanted but that wasn't on him. He is very kind and I enjoyed his lectures.

Professor Frauenfeld is literally the nicest human. He genuinely wants you to do well in his class and with a little work on the tougher units, you can. His lectures are similar to what he quizzes you on and this year he posed the slides before class which was very helpful. I would absolutely take him again, really great class to take for credit

Really, really nice guy and easy to talk to. Class is very content heavy, so even though attendance is not optional, be sure to go. Notes during class is all you need to study for his quizzes. No tests.

He was a super nice prof and made the class enjoyable. I'm not a GEOG major but I went to class every day and studied a good amount and made a 100 in the class. This class was fair not to easy and not too hard. Got to go to class because test are mostly based on lecture notes and he gives random quizzes but they are easy and help bump up your grade.

Not a super interesting class, but Dr. Frauenfeld makes it way more enjoyable. reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

I fell in love with his lectures and actually looked forward to going to class every day. His tests are very fair. He does have pop quizzes that are a surprise, but they're easy. Those questions end up on the exam.

If you go to class, take good notes, and review them a couple days before the test you should be fine. Lecture is sometimes slow but could be worse. He gave quizzes in class with questions very similar to test questions to help (not worth much) that also had extra credit on them. Cares about students, recommend meeting him in office hours.

Dr. Frauenfeld is awesome, the material is pretty dry but he's a goofy guy so he makes the class a lot more interesting. There's three exams and about 10 pop quizzes. reviews.comment: This class contains 3 exams and pop quizzes. The pop quizzes are given to help you and your grade! reviews.comment: Basically tests are your only grades in the class so it's important to pay attention in lectures and study hard for them. He gives pop quizzes around once a week to help boost grade for attendance. Really nice guy and willing to help if needed.

Frauenfeld is extremely intelligent and is not a boring professor. Tests are so hard. There's a pop quiz at least once a week and he grades fairly on them. Show up to class and take very detailed notes. The tests increase in difficulty as the semester goes on.
Loved this class. Lectures seemed long but that's just because he lectures for all of it. Really enjoyed it though and he wanted to make sure everyone understood.

Decent prof but this class is pretty boring. He attempts to make it interesting but its very difficult to get into.  Attendance quizzes at random mean you have to attend the lectures, but they are 50% sign your name 50% knowledge. Tests use conceptual questions so you have to know the coursework/concepts. Not an easy course, but manageable overall.

He gives pop quizzes but they're pretty easy. They also are indicative of the type and degree of difficulty of the exam questions so that's actually helpful. He drops your lowest quiz grade too. Dr. Frauenfeld does a good job making the material more interesting than it could otherwise be. He's pretty nice and funny. The tests aren't that hard.

He's awesome. Just don't take this class if you have heavy course load because it takes sometime to properly read through the material and understand all the concepts.  Other than that, he tries to make the class interesting by throwing in a few jokes here and there.
Tests are straight from lectures only. Pop quizes that are worth 10 points each, missing these can be detrimental to your grade. Tests aren't that bad but you definitely need to study.

I liked this professor, but not the class. I felt like I grasped most of the material, yet still did awful on the tests. He only tests over his lectures, so the book is not required, however not sure where some of the information came from. I went to every lecture, took great notes and studied a lot and still bombed the tests.

His class is an easy A as long as you come and put forth a little effort. I read the textbook and probably didn't need to. His tests are straight from the notes. Have to come to class because he doesn't post said notes and he gives easy attendance pop quizzes. Easy science credited. Subject material is like earth science you take in Elementary.

He likes to randomly give pop quizzes, which is annoying because you have to actually go to class and sit through the super long and boring lectures. He posts powerpoints to ecampus, but they're only pictures so they're completely useless. Tests were kind of difficult and I'm not sure where some of the material came from.

Dr Frauenfeld is a pretty good professor. Three tests and pop quizzes normally once a week. Not really a lot of outside of class work which is nice. He posts slides online but theyre only the pictures from his lectures. To get the words, you must go to class. I found the book helpful as well but it isn't required. Not hard to make an A if you study

There are three tests and weekly pop quizzes. As long as you show up for class and take good notes, you'll be fine. I'm not a science person, but Dr. Frauenfeld is funny and made the class really interesting (as much as that's possible). Would definitely recommend for anyone who needs a science class.

Great professor overall. Explains things clearly and will clarify again if needed. He does give pop quizzes randomly, but these are easy if you take notes and pay some attention. Tests questions are like the quizzes. Just study your notes and you'll at least have a B.
Seriously the best professor ever!!!

Dr. Frauenfeld is a very easy to approach professor who is also passionate about what he teaches. I struggled with some of his tests but overall if you put forth the effort, it isn't too difficult because he's very understanding and reasonable. He also has a huge curve at the end of the year which really saved my grade.
LOVE HIM!!
Dr. Frauenfeld is the best professor at A&M!

Really great professor! He is willing to help you out anytime after class or in his office. The subject gets a little boring at times, but he tries to liven things up. I received a B with very little effort, so getting an A is certainly possible with some effort. Overall, I would definitely recommend him to anyone needing a science credit!
He's awesome. Not too bad on the eyes.

I loved Dr. Frauenfeld. He was by far my favorite professor this semester. His tests are word for word his lectures. Anything and everything he says could be tested, but nothing else, aka there are no curveballs on the tests. Theres no final, only three tests, but they're easy if you study some. Bad thing is he gives pop quizzes, but they're easy.
